fix: ViewController::notify (and ViewAnchorController::notify at lines 845-851 with the same pattern) allocates a fresh Vec of upgraded listeners on every published event, and clones `event` once per listener. Keep the upgraded list in a reusable scratch buffer owned by ViewState (e.g. `scratch: Vec<Rc<dyn Fn(ViewEvent)>>`, filled with `clear()` + `extend`, then drained after the borrow is released), and move `event` into the last listener instead of cloning for every listener. Keeps the borrow released before callbacks run.
